name: Wei Shu San Dian Wu
source:
You will experience qin xian, the protagonist, in the third person, a story of ordinary people caught up in a larger event than the universe -- a dimensional event. In this absurd life, your choice on behalf of qin xian determines the fate of his universe.

"We are all celestial bodies in the vast universe. I am the planet that spins alone in the orbit of the star."
"What about me?
"You are the planet I captured in my galaxy."
"Don't you like it?
"No. If your friends come, they'll take you away."
"..."
"All I needed was one person spinning stupidly in my orbit."
'and if I go?
"If you go, I shall bear the sad remembrance."
"No, if they come, you'll probably follow me."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1167590/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你将以第三人称视角，经历主人公秦弦的故事。他原本只是个普通人，却被卷入了比宇宙还要宏大的事件——关乎维度的事件。在这荒谬的人生中，你替秦弦作出的选择，竟决定着他所在宇宙的命运。

“我们都是广阔宇宙中的天体。我是那颗在恒星规定的轨道上孤独自转的行星。”
“那我呢？”
“你是我在星系里捕获的行星。”
“你不喜欢吗？”
“不喜欢。如果你的伙伴来了，他们就会把你带走。”
“…”
“本来我只需要一个人在自己的轨道上傻傻地自转就好了。”
“要是我走了呢？”
“如果你走了，我就得忍受那悲伤的回忆。”
“不会的，如果他们来了，你大概会跟我一起走。”

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1167590/]Steam[/url]]
